description: This Dart source file defines the 'RestaurantDetailScreen' widget for a Flutter app. It displays details of a restaurant, including its menu, fetched from providers. It also includes a sub-widget '_MenuTile' for displaying individual menu items with options to add them to a cart.

classes.name: RestaurantDetailScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that displays details of a restaurant including its menu and provides navigation to cart.

classes.name: _MenuTile
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays individual menu item details and allows adding the item to the cart.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the RestaurantDetailScreen widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and triggers fetching the menu for the restaurant.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the restaurant detail screen including list of menu items.

methods.name: _MenuTile.build
methods.description: Builds the UI for a single menu item, including image, name, description, price, and add-to-cart button.
